entries.name: DARK SOULS™: REMASTERED Weapon DPS Script
entries.tooltip:
A Tampermonkey script that adds a “DPS R1” column to the Dark Souls weapon table on soulsplanner.com/darksouls/weaponatk.
It uses per-weapon R1 attack speed (APS) with boss/enemy resistance calculator (Regular / Strike / Slash / Thrust + Magic / Fire / Lightning).
The guide explains the exact formulas used for damage after defense, Bleed damage over time, Black Knight vs Chaos Demon bonus, and Occult vs Occult-weak bonus.
Under its assumptions (pure R1 spam, no downtime), you can sort by DPS and see the mathematically optimal weapon for any given boss or custom enemy setup.

entries.name: Gear Score
entries.tooltip:
Puts a score on every weapon and shield, so you can compare gear at a glance. Shows on item cards in your backpack, vending machines, mission rewards and loot on the ground. Page Up / Page Down in the backpack lists everything you carry, best first.

Weapon score (DPS):
shots x damage x pellets / (shots x fire interval + reload)
shots = magazine size / ammo used per shot

Shield score (Shield Power):
capacity + recharge rate x (breather - recharge delay), the recharge part at most one full bar

Values are read straight off the item, unrounded, so they can differ slightly from the card. Character skills are not counted.

- Disregard Accuracy: on = every bullet hits. Off = DPS scaled by the gun's accuracy
- Disregard Critical: on = ignore crits. Off = DPS multiplied by the gun's crit bonus, as if every shot crits
- Disregard Elements: on = ignore burn, shock and corrosion. Off = adds elemental damage, scaled by the x1 to x4 rating
- Disregard Zig-Zag Bullets: on = guns like the Madjack are scored by how often their bullets can hit. Off = scored as if every shot lands
- Compare vs current gear: marks how the gun stands against your best of all, of its type, of its element, and of both
- Score font size: how big the score prints on the card
- Score Shields: shield scores on or off
- Breather Seconds: how long you expect between bursts of enemy fire. 0 rates shields by capacity alone
- Clean Up Inventory: drops everything that is not your best, equipped gear included

entries.name: Hide Full Pickups
entries.tooltip: Hides ammo pickups you have no room for. Anything that would say FULL loses its beam and icon, and comes back once you spend some ammo.

entries.name: Infinite Ammo
entries.tooltip:
Infinite ammo. Firing never uses any up.

- No Reload: also stops the magazine emptying, so you never reload

entries.name: Infinite Health
entries.tooltip: Infinite health. You cannot die.

entries.name: Jump Higher
entries.tooltip:
Higher jumps than the game normally allows.

- Jump Height: how high you jump. Game default is 630
- Optional: debug setting to see jump height values

entries.name: Loot Radar
entries.tooltip:
Puts loot and unopened chests on your compass, with the distance to each one. Ammo and health you have no room for is left out.

Colours: green = weapons and items, yellow = money, blue = ammo, pink = health, red = red chest, white = white chest, deep pink = Knoxx chest

- Toggle each type on or off: weapons, money, ammo, health, red chests, white chests, Knoxx chests
- Display Only Better Weapons: hides gear worse than the weakest of that type you already carry, and blocks picking it up. Uses the same scores as Gear Score: DPS for weapons, Shield Power for shields
- Hide Full Pickups: hides ammo and health you have no room for
- Show Distance: distance above each mark
- Units: metres or feet
- Checks per second: how often loot and chests are looked for. Lower is better for performance

entries.name: Mission Progress
entries.tooltip:
Tracks your mission progress and total game completion, following the Borderlands mission order.

Colours: blue = game completion, yellow = the mission you are tracking, red = missions you skipped past, grey = what comes next

- Position: top right, top left or top centre
- Enable DLC Missions: 216 missions instead of 126
- Upcoming missions shown: how many missions to list ahead
- Flag Skipped Missions: the red list on or off
- Achievement Warnings: warns when a known bug in your current mission can cost you an achievement
- Enable Side Missions: side missions counted and listed, or main missions only
- Sort By: mission flow, or level, which lists only the missions you can take right now
- Text Size: 50% to 150% of the normal size
- Show Mission Location: a smaller line under each mission with where it is and who gives it

entries.name: Movement Speed Changer
entries.tooltip:
Set your own speed for walking, running, aiming, crouching and driving. Each slider shows the game default next to it.

- Walking, Running, Aiming, Crouching: speed on foot
- Driving: top speed of any vehicle
- Optional: debug setting to see speed values

entries.name: No Backpack Limit
entries.tooltip:
Set your own backpack size.

- Backpack slots: how many slots you get

entries.name: No Recoil
entries.tooltip:
No recoil on any weapon.

- Also Stop Spread: every shot lands dead centre instead of scattering

entries.name: No Reload
entries.tooltip: Infinite magazine. It never empties, so you never reload.

entries.name: No Skill Cooldown
entries.tooltip: No cooldown on your action skill. It is ready every time you press the key. Pressing it while the skill is active restarts it.

entries.name: Repeat Mission
entries.tooltip:
Replay any mission you have already finished.

- Mission: pick one from your log
- Repeat Selected Mission: puts it back in your log to do again
- Ready to Turn In: sets it straight to ready to hand in
- Mark Complete: marks it finished
- Refresh the List: reload what is in your log

- Reset Red Chests / Reset White Chests / Reset Knoxx Chests: which types are included

entries.tooltip:

- Optional: debug setting to see speed values

entries.name: Use No Reload

entries.name: Vehicle Jump
entries.tooltip:

- Jump Height: how far off the ground the vehicle goes
- Optional: debug setting to see jump height values

entries.name: Infinite Money

- Money: how much you carry

entries.name: Random Vehicle Colour
entries.tooltip:
Gives every vehicle you spawn a random paint job, from the eight colours the Catch-a-Ride offers.

- Pick at the terminal: on = the colour is picked when you open the Catch-a-Ride, so you see it first. Off = picked when you press Spawn Vehicle

entries.name: No Clip
entries.tooltip:
Lets you fly through walls. Press the key to lift off, and again to drop back on your feet.

- Fly Speed: how fast you move while flying

entries.name: Auto Loot
entries.tooltip:
Picks loot up as you walk over it, no key press needed. It never swaps out the gun you are holding, and anything you are full on stays on the ground.

- Loot Everything in the Area: press it to take every item lying in the area, however far away
- Loot Weapons / Loot Money / Loot Ammo / Loot Health: which types get picked up
- Loot Gear You Cannot Use: also picks up gear your character cannot use yet
- Reach in metres: how close loot has to be
- Checks per second: how often loot is looked for. Lower is better for performance

entries.name: Reset Enemies
entries.tooltip:
Brings the enemies in the area back without reloading your save.

- Reset Current Area: press it, close the menu, and the enemies come back at their spawn points

entries.name: Clear Loot
entries.tooltip:
Removes every item lying on the ground in the area.

- Clear Loot in This Area: press it, close the menu, and the loot on the ground is gone

entries.name: Enemy Weakness Indicator
entries.tooltip:
Shows the best weapon type, element and weak spot for the enemy under your crosshair. The gun type and element turn green when the gun in your hand matches and red when it does not.

- The gun type comes from the game's data: whether the enemy flies, its size, whether it fights up close or with a gun, and how much its weak spot pays
- The element is None when no element beats a plain gun
- The weak spot is the body part the game marks as critical, with its damage multiplier, such as pods x300
- An enemy carrying a pack you can shoot off its back, such as a Badass Chemical Trooper, says so

entries.name: Audio Output Selector
entries.tooltip:
Picks which audio device the game plays through, without restarting it, plus a master volume slider.

- Audio Output Device: the device the game plays through
- Apply: moves the game's sound to the picked device
- Scan Devices: looks again for devices, such as one plugged in after the game started
- Master Volume: the volume of everything the game plays

- Weapon Flicker: the light that blinks on the walls with each shot
- Gun Explosions: the small burst an elemental bullet sets off where it lands
- Bullet Decals: the sparks where a bullet lands
- Bullet Trails: the glowing dots an elemental bullet leaves on its way

entries.name: Full Money Indicator

entries.name: Open All Chests

entries.name: One Shot One Kill

Picks which audio device the game plays through, without restarting it, plus a master volume slider.

- Audio Output Device: the device the game plays through
- Apply: moves the game's sound to the picked device
- Scan Devices: looks again for devices, such as one plugged in after the game started
- Master Volume: the volume of everything the game plays

entries.name: No Weapon Flash (Epilepsy Friendly)
entries.tooltip:
Removes the flashes and sparks from gunfire, yours and enemies', each with its own setting.

- Weapon Muzzle: the flame at the barrel when a gun fires
- Weapon Flicker: the light that blinks on the walls with each shot
- Gun Explosions: the small burst an elemental bullet sets off where it lands
- Bullet Decals: the sparks where a bullet lands
- Bullet Trails: the glowing dots an elemental bullet leaves on its way

entries.name: Best Weapon and Element for Every Enemy and Boss
entries.tooltip: Lists the best gun type and element for every enemy and boss, and which element to avoid.

entries.name: Full Money Indicator
entries.tooltip: Shows the full amount of money you carry, past the 9,999,999 the game displays. The game can hold up to $2,147,483,647, and money that goes past that is kept at that top.

entries.name: Open All Chests
entries.tooltip:
Opens every red, white and Knoxx chest and strong box in the area with one button.

- Open Chests in This Area: press it, close the menu, and every shut chest around you opens

entries.name: One Shot One Kill
entries.tooltip: Every enemy and enemy vehicle you hit dies from that hit: bullets, grenades, rockets and melee alike. It still counts as your kill, so you get the XP and the loot as normal.

entries.name: Viewmodel Changer
entries.tooltip: Sets where your gun sits on screen and its field of view, for each gun type.

entries.name: HUD Cleaner
entries.tooltip: Hides the parts of the HUD you pick.

entries.name: Reset Shop
entries.tooltip: Fills the shops you are standing at with new items at the press of a key.

entries.name: Skill Limit
entries.tooltip:
Set a target number of actions or items on a skill and it stops there. A bar appears where you start the skill, with an amount, a mode switch and a live counter.

- Actions: counts how many times the action is performed
- Items: counts what lands in your bank
- Amount and mode are remembered per skill and per character
- In Woodcutting each tree has its own target, so the others keep going
- Combat, Astrology, Agility and Alt Magic are not affected

entries.name: No Flashing
entries.tooltip:
Removes the flashing, flickering, strobing and screen shake, in the base game and The Delicious Last Course.

- Each part can be switched off on its own in the F1 settings window
- Flashes drawn into the animations, such as super attacks, are not removed

entries.name: Overall Rating
entries.tooltip:
Adds an Overall rating for every player and team, on the PS2 version played in PCSX2.

- Edit Player and the formation screen: an Overall row for each player
- Team select: the team's Overall next to its name, in Exhibition, cups, leagues and Master League

entries.name: Optimal Squad
entries.tooltip:
Adds Optimal Squad to the formation screen menu, on the PS2 version played in PCSX2. It picks the best starting eleven, using only players who can play each position.

- Optimal Ability: highest total Overall
- Optimal Condition: players in the best form first
- Both: Overall after form, as the match uses it
- Keep Formation: change only the players, or let it pick the formation too

entries.name: Real Names
entries.tooltip:
Renames the fake clubs, players, stadiums and competitions to their real names, on the PS2 version played in PCSX2.

- 69 clubs, with their real short names
- Fake-named players, plus 207 national team players the game already stores real names for
- 27 stadiums and the league and cup names

entries.name: Guided Play Overhaul
entries.tooltip:
A guided play overhaul for Hinterland, built around all 9 Steam achievements: a window over the game works out your next move from the game's own rules and points to it with a compass arrow.

- What to fight and when it is safe, what to wear, loot, hire, build and research
- Auto-attack, auto potion and one-click potions
- WASD and arrow keys that move along the screen, and mouse wheel zoom

entries.name: Progress
entries.tooltip:
Adds PROGRESS to the Start menu of Pokémon Red: everything still left for 100%, and the next step to get there. An IPS patch for your own copy of the game.

- Nine lists: story, Pokédex, items, hidden items, gifts, trainers, trades, one-off Pokémon and towns
- NEXT follows one route through all of them, showing only what you can do now
- Press SELECT while walking to see the next step
- A warning before anything can be lost for good

entries.name: Repo Declutter
entries.tooltip: Clears the build and cache folders that rebuild themselves from every repository in a folder at once, and finds API keys and tokens committed to git, including in old commits.

entries.name: Deskswitch
entries.tooltip: Turns screens on and off and sets the main screen with one hotkey, using saved profiles.

entries.name: Audio EQ Overlay
entries.tooltip: A parametric equaliser for every app on the computer at once, with up to ten bands, high and low pass filters, a live analyser and saved presets.

entries.name: Audio Mixer Widget
entries.tooltip: A volume slider and mute button for every app playing sound, plus the master volume. The sliders can also be used from a phone or tablet browser.

entries.name: Fret Tuner
entries.tooltip: A tuner for guitar, bass and ukulele that shows the note, the octave and how many cents off it is, with sixteen tunings.

entries.name: Snuffed
entries.tooltip: Counts the time since the last cigarette and marks 19 health milestones from 20 minutes to 20 years. It also works out the money saved and keeps a history of relapses.

entries.name: Product Data Grabber
entries.tooltip: Copies the text and photos from product pages on 16 online stores, and compares a product's price across 18 stores by price per kilo.

entries.name: Store Asset Studio
entries.tooltip: Makes every app icon and store image for the Microsoft Store, Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, Chrome, favicons, social images and Flatpak from one image. It also resizes screenshots to the sizes the Apple and Microsoft stores accept.

entries.name: Job Yard
entries.tooltip: Searches 44 Portuguese job sites, recruitment agencies and remote job boards at once and lists every job in one place, filtered by location, work mode, salary and words to leave out.

entries.name: Audio Mix Analyzer
entries.tooltip: Measures a song's frequency spectrum, loudness and stereo width, live as it plays or from the file, and exports the readings as text, CSV and PNG.

entries.name: NoteStash
entries.tooltip: A note board that sorts notes into boards and columns, with colour labels, images and search, all stored on the PC.

entries.name: PageWise
entries.tooltip: Pulls all of the text out of a PDF, or saves a copy without the pages you tick. The original file is never changed.

entries.name: ROM Reaper
entries.tooltip: Converts game disc images and ROMs to smaller formats emulators read, such as CHD, RVZ and 7z, and checks every new file against the original.

entries.name: SideWire
entries.tooltip: Sends notes and files between your own devices, over the local Wi-Fi or anywhere with end-to-end encryption, with no account.

entries.name: Video Caption Grabber
entries.tooltip: Shows the captions of a YouTube video as text from its link, in any caption language it has, to copy or save as TXT, SRT or WebVTT.

entries.name: 4 am
entries.tooltip: C#m, 130 BPM

entries.name: life is strange
entries.tooltip: Gmaj, 120 BPM

entries.name: windshield
entries.tooltip: Dm, 90 BPM

entries.name: amalfi
entries.tooltip: Am, 90 BPM

entries.name: Clock Yard
entries.tooltip: Runs countdowns, quick timers, Pomodoro and interval timers, stopwatches, counters and clocks side by side on boards. Alerts ring while the app is closed, and timers can sync across devices.
